feeds.title: Live Japan
feeds.description: Japan's famous sightseeing locations and activities for tourists from abroad! Introducing a wide range of information, from the greater Japan area's most talked about shops, sightseeing spots and events to the souvenirs you can find there.

feeds.title: Japan Travel
feeds.description: JapanTravel.com is the leading resource for Japan travel information and the primary destination for visitors planning and travelling to Japan. Japan Travel guides travellers to new and exciting destinations around Japan, providing the tourism information, resources, maps and tools to help you plan, book and prepare for the perfect trip.

feeds.title: Japan Wonder Travel Blog
feeds.description: Learn about the wonders of Japan including everything from the best things to do, travel itineraries, as well as food, cultural and historical, and seasonal and event related content

feeds.title: Gaijin Pot Blog
feeds.description: GaijinPot is based around the five pillars we think every newcomer needs to build on in order to have a successful life in Japan: Find jobs, Study, Live, Travel, and Understand Japan.

feeds.title: InsideJapan Tours Blog
feeds.description: The InsideJapan Tours blog is where our experts come to discuss everything Japan-related, from their favourite places to exciting new hotspots. InsideJapan Tours is an award-winning travel brand specializing in group tours, tailormade travel and cultural experiences across Japan.

feeds.title: 2 Aussie Travellers
feeds.description: Japan is a unique and beautiful country to travel in. We share detailed guides and tips to get the most our of your visit and stretch your travel dollars.

feeds.title: Arigato Travel Blog
feeds.description: Arigato Travel is a Japanese food tour blog, helping you create delicious memories through our Walking Food Tours. Their blog offers articles on must-eat, traditional cuisine, restaurants, streets, and more.

feeds.title: Tourist in Japan
feeds.description: Hi there! Are you planning a trip to Japan? Or maybe you just love everything Japan? Then I'm sure you will be happy to discover all the content I've collected here. I hope you will find inspiration for your own trip to Japan, or maybe get inspired to go visit the land of the rising sun.

feeds.title: Japan Starts Here: Japan Travel Blog for Information and Inspiration
feeds.description: My name is Robert Schrader. On my blog you'll find Destination Guides, helping choose where to go, or travel advice for deeper insights. My travel blog provides an up-close and personal look into the day-to-day of every trip I take to Japan. And Itineraries, that recommends accommodation, transport, meals and activities for the duration of your trip.

feeds.title: Its Your Japan
feeds.description: Your Japan is a web magazine dedicated to sharing the beauty of Japan and is a guide for a new source of information about Japan. Find articles on Travel, Culture, Lifestyle, and Food.

feeds.title: Asian Wanderlust Blog
feeds.description: Discover in these blog posts all you need to know before your trip to Japan. It includes the best places to visit, travel tips and more. Since 2015, I travel around Asia and I share with you my tips to discover this gorgeous side of the planet.

feeds.title: WarmCheapTrips
feeds.description: Hey, this is Michela, an Italian travel blogger based in Tokyo. I aim to inspire everyone to travel, reporting my travels, providing useful information and overall explaining how travel is an experience that everyone can and must yield: you can travel on a budget without sacrificing comfort.

feeds.title: Suitcase Travel Blog » Japan
feeds.description: To find destinations to explore, authentic Japanese food & culture, travel guides & tips, and more, read articles from the following segment of Suitcase Travel Blog. Hello! I'm Angela. The Suitcase is my travel blog. I would like to share my travelling experiences: how to travel inexpensively yet comfortably, and see as much as possible on a short vacation.

feeds.title: Japan Australia
feeds.description: Japan Australia is a blog about Japan containing useful tips and advice for living or travelling to Japan. This blog is dedicated to Japan travel, food, culture and modern life in Japan.

feeds.title: Matcha
feeds.description: MATCHA is a web magazine dedicated to bringing the rich culture and history of Japan to an international audience. On these pages, you will find everything you could hope for about this island nation - from famous sightseeing destinations in major cities like Tokyo and Kyoto to little-known spots around the country, to information on regional delicacies, comfortable accommodations to suit every budget, and even articles on where you can find the best souvenirs to remember your trip by.

feeds.title: Boutique Japan Blog
feeds.description: The Boutique Japan blog is a comprehensive resource of up-to-date Japan travel information, advice, and insightful inspiration for your trip. Boutique Japan is an award-winning travel company specializing in unique Japan experiences

feeds.title: Sugoii Japan
feeds.description: At Sugoii Japan, we are passionate Tokyo-based writers and photographers and we show you Japan and its culture through our eyes.

feeds.title: Asiatravelbug
feeds.description: Travel better with Asiatravelbug's Japan Travel Guide. Before you go, learn why you need pocket wifi in Japan, how to see Mount Fuji at its best, where to stay, and other practical Japan travel tips for a stress-free amazing Japan vacation! Tiffy, a.k.a. asiatravelbug, is a travel planning freak, an ex-finance manager and currently a digital marketing ninja.

feeds.title: Hokkaido Treasure Island Travel Inc Blog
feeds.description: Hokkaido Treasure Island Travel Inc. is a DMC (Destination Management Company) based in Sapporo, the capital city of the island. Our team is dedicated to planning high-quality, authentic and tailored itineraries for all travelers to enjoy the many treasures this island has to offer.

feeds.title: Japan Travel Mate
feeds.description: Japan Travel Mate is more than a Japan travel guide, it's also a blog about all things related to Japan.

feeds.title: Japan Guide
feeds.description: This web site exists since July 2, 1996. Our goal is to deliver comprehensive, up-to-date information on travelling in Japan, first-hand from Japan. Our blog is about everything modern and traditional Japan with emphasis on travel and living related information.

feeds.title: Japan Rail Pass Blog
feeds.description: Discover Japan with the Japan Rail Pass Blog. Keep up with travel guides, transportation tips, planning resources, itineraries, trains, recommendations and much more!

feeds.title: Deep Japan
feeds.description: Japanese culture and Japan travel and tourism site featuring Japanese travel advice from local Senpai. Learn about Japanese food culture and traditions.
